info.album: The Very Best Of Sting And The Police

podcast.body: This song from "Ten Summoners Tales" paired courtly lyrics about undying love amidst rolling hills of barley with some of Sting's smoothest music. While it peaked at number 23 on the Hot 100 in summer 1993, it spent a month at number two on Billboard's Adult Contemporary Chart. As of 2025, it is Sting's most played solo single ever on both radio and Spotify. "Since of 2025, Fields of Gold is Sting's most played solo single ever, both on the radio and Spotify."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
